recoil.scope: Integer-frame authoring transform/glow checks only; not continuous collision, native interpolation or gameplay QA

surface_sweep.scope: Quarter-frame triangle surface intersections against other visible scene meshes; excludes same-owner parts. Does not detect complete containment, hands, native interpolation or establish clearance tolerance. Existing baseline intersections tracked separately.

geometry.scope: Static evaluated world-space triangle area only; no hand or collision or native acceptance

export.axis_mapping: Blender -X becomes model +Z at 4 model units per Blender unit
limits: Geometry must export matching bone names and coordinate frame
